citations.excerpt: The Anglican Church in North America was founded in 2009 by more traditional Anglicans from North America.

facts.value: Founded in 2009 by more traditional Anglicans from North America. It remains connected with the Anglican Communion and seeks a more traditional expression of Anglicanism than the Episcopal Church.
